acceptance_met: Acknowledge assignments only after the local transition is applied: kip848_acks_assignment_only_after_apply proves the heartbeat loop sends no assignment echo at the new epoch before poll applies the shrink, and echoes the applied assignment after (mock cg_heartbeat_acks recording).

Handle member fencing, changed member IDs, lost heartbeat responses and coordinator moves without using stale metadata for commits: poll/commit now reconcile via check_kip848_membership (rejoin on FENCED_MEMBER_EPOCH/UNKNOWN_MEMBER_ID, surface other sticky errors); the heartbeat task and poll path share adopted member IDs (hb_member_id slot); heartbeat_join drops stale pre-join pending assignments. Proven by kip848_rejoins_after_fencing_without_stale_commit, kip848_adopts_changed_member_id, kip848_recovers_after_lost_heartbeat_responses, kip848_fencing_rejoin_preserves_delivered_position, plus existing coordinator-move/drop tests.

Classify decode/reconnect failures observably rather than silently spinning forever: undecodable heartbeat payloads store an INVALID_REQUEST sentinel surfaced from poll (kip848_decode_failure_surfaces_in_poll); transport failures stay silent-retry by design and are proven recoverable (lost-response test).
commands: cargo test --locked --test full_surface kip848 -- --test-threads=2 (14 passed: 9 existing + 5 new, exit 0)
Pre-fix failures observed: fencing (never rejoined, 5s), rotation (no adopt, 2s), decode (poll Ok, unwrap_err panic)
limits: Default-parallelism runs flake on the loaded host (Timeout at producer seeding; pre-existing, also on pristine tree); suites pass with --test-threads=2/4.

A single transient decode blip may or may not fail one poll depending on heartbeat timing (matches the pre-existing bad-interval sentinel precedent); persistent corruption always surfaces. The test uses a 3-burst for determinism.
Transport reconnect failures do not fail polls by design (transient tolerance, Java-like); only decode violations surface. No new metrics dimension was added.
Leave after fencing without an intervening poll/commit still sends the fenced epoch and may report the broker error; leave-after-fencing tolerance was left out of scope.
